ecotourism--noun.def: Travel to natural places in a way that protects them.

edification--noun.def: Moral or intellectual improvement gained from something.
edification--noun.ex: He read the letters for our edification.

edify--verb.def: To teach someone in a way that improves their character.

egalitarian--adj.def: Believing that all people deserve equal rights.
egalitarian--adj.ex: They built an egalitarian school system.

egalitarian--noun.def: Someone who believes everyone should be treated equally.

eke-out--verb.def: To make a small supply last, or to survive with difficulty.
eke-out--verb.ex: They eked out a living from the land.

elephantine--adj.def: Very large and clumsy in movement.
elephantine--adj.ex: The machine moves with elephantine slowness.
elephantine--adj.exTr: Makine fil gibi ağır hareket ediyor.

embed--verb.def: To fix something firmly inside something else.
embed--verb.ex: Embed the chart in the report.

emolument--noun.def: Payment received for holding an office.
emolument--noun.ex: The post carries a small emolument.

emulation--noun.def: The copying of someone admired, or imitation by a computer.

emulsification--noun.def: The mixing of two liquids that do not normally combine.

emulsifier--noun.def: A substance that helps oil and water stay mixed.
emulsifier--noun.ex: Egg yolk acts as an emulsifier.

emulsify--verb.def: To combine two liquids into a smooth mixture.

enabler--noun.def: A person or thing that makes something possible, often something harmful.
enabler--noun.ex: The bank was an enabler of the fraud.

encompass--verb.def: To include a wide range of things.

encumber--verb.def: To weigh someone down so they cannot move or act freely.

encumbrance--noun.def: Something that holds you back, or a legal claim on property.
encumbrance--noun.ex: The house is sold free of encumbrance.

enduringly--adv.def: In a way that continues for a very long time.

engender--verb.def: To cause a feeling or situation to come into being.

enthuse--verb.def: To speak about something with great excitement.
enthuse--verb.ex: She enthused about the new job.

ephemera--noun.tr: günlük basılı malzeme, kısa ömürlü şeyler
ephemera--noun.def: Printed items meant to be used once and thrown away.
ephemera--noun.exTr: Müze savaş dönemi günlük basılı malzemesini topluyor.

ephemerality--noun.def: The quality of lasting a very short time.
ephemerality--noun.ex: The ephemerality of fame surprised him.

equable--adj.def: Calm and even, said of a temper or a climate.
equable--adj.ex: The island has an equable climate.

etching--noun.def: A print made from a design cut into metal.
etching--noun.ex: An etching of the harbour hangs there.

euphemistic--adj.def: Using mild words in place of blunt ones.

euphemistically--adv.def: By using a softer word than the plain one.
euphemistically--adv.exTr: Ona örtmeceli biçimde yeniden yapılanma deniyor.

euphorically--adv.def: With an intense but short-lived happiness.

exaltedly--adv.def: In a way that suggests high rank or lofty feeling.
exaltedly--adv.ex: He spoke exaltedly of his teacher.
exaltedly--adv.exTr: Hocasından yüceltici bir edayla söz etti.

extant--adj.def: Still existing, especially after a long time.

fabulate--verb.def: To invent a story and tell it as if true.
fabulate--verb.ex: The old sailor liked to fabulate.

fabulation--noun.def: The telling of invented stories as though real.

farcical--adj.def: So absurd that it cannot be taken seriously.

flat-out--adv.def: As fast or as hard as possible.
flat-out--adv.ex: The team worked flat out for a week.
flat-out--adv.exTr: Ekip bir hafta var gücüyle çalıştı.

flightiness--noun.def: The habit of changing interests without warning.
flightiness--noun.ex: Her flightiness cost her the post.

floe--noun.def: A large flat sheet of ice floating on the sea.

fluctuate--verb.def: To rise and fall repeatedly in level or amount.

forlornly--adv.def: In a lonely and hopeless way.
forlornly--adv.ex: The dog waited forlornly at the door.
forlornly--adv.exTr: Köpek kapıda hüzünlü bir hâlde bekledi.

formidably--adv.def: In a way that inspires respect or fear through strength.

fractious--adj.def: Easily upset and hard to control.

genomic--adj.def: Relating to the complete set of genes of a living thing.

genomically--adv.def: In terms of the whole set of an organism's genes.

glitzy--adj.ex: They held a glitzy launch party.

glory-in--verb.def: To take great pleasure or pride in something.
glory-in--verb.ex: He gloried in his son's success.

gravitate--verb.def: To move steadily towards something you are drawn to.

gravitationally--adv.def: Through the force that pulls masses together.

haphazardly--adv.ex: Books lay haphazardly on the floor.

happenstance--noun.def: Chance, rather than plan or intention.

haughtily--adv.def: In a proud way that looks down on others.

hauntingly--adv.def: In a beautiful sad way that stays in the memory.

hermetic--adj.def: Completely sealed, or closed off from outsiders.
hermetic--adj.ex: The group lives a hermetic life.
hermetic--adj.exTr: Grup içine kapalı bir hayat sürüyor.

histrionic--adj.def: Overly dramatic in a way that seems insincere.

histrionically--adv.ex: She histrionically threw up her hands.
histrionically--adv.exTr: Abartılı bir dramla ellerini havaya attı.

hotelier--noun.def: A person who owns or manages a hotel.
hotelier--noun.ex: A local hotelier bought the building.
hotelier--noun.exTr: Yerel bir otelci binayı satın aldı.

hypnotherapy--noun.def: Treatment of a problem using hypnosis.
hypnotherapy--noun.ex: She tried hypnotherapy to stop smoking.

hypothesize--verb.def: To suggest an explanation that still needs testing.
hypothesize--verb.exTr: Bilim insanları erken bir çarpışma varsayıyor.

idiomatic--adj.def: Using language the way native speakers naturally do.
idiomatic--adj.ex: His English is fluent and idiomatic.

idiomatically--adv.def: In the natural phrasing of native speakers.
idiomatically--adv.ex: Translate it idiomatically, not word for word.

idiosyncrasy--noun.def: An unusual habit that belongs to one person alone.
idiosyncrasy--noun.ex: Writing standing up is his idiosyncrasy.
idiosyncrasy--noun.exTr: Ayakta yazmak ona özgü bir tuhaflık.

idiosyncratic--adj.def: Peculiar to one person and unlike anyone else's.
idiosyncratic--adj.ex: She has an idiosyncratic filing system.
idiosyncratic--adj.exTr: Kendine özgü bir dosyalama sistemi var.

ignominious--adj.def: Causing public shame and loss of respect.
ignominious--adj.ex: The team suffered an ignominious defeat.
ignominious--adj.exTr: Takım utanç verici bir yenilgi aldı.

ignominiously--adv.def: In a way that brings public shame.

imperceptible--adj.def: So slight that it cannot be noticed.

imperceptibly--adv.def: In a way too small or slow to notice.

impressionistic--adj.def: Based on general impressions rather than exact detail.

impressionistically--adv.def: By giving a general feeling rather than precise facts.

improvisational--adj.def: Made up as you go, without preparation.
improvisational--adj.ex: The band has an improvisational style.
improvisational--adj.exTr: Grubun doğaçlamaya dayalı bir tarzı var.

inartistic--adj.def: Showing no skill in or feeling for art.
inartistic--adj.ex: The repair was clumsy and inartistic.

inchoate--adj.def: Just beginning and not yet fully formed.

inchoately--adv.def: In a way that is only beginning to take shape.

incipient--adj.def: Starting to appear but not yet developed.
incipient--adj.exTr: Doktorlar başlangıç hâlinde bir enfeksiyon buldu.

incise--verb.def: To cut a line or mark into a surface.

incongruity--noun.def: The state of not fitting with what surrounds it.

incongruous--adj.def: Looking out of place in its setting.

incongruously--adv.def: In a way that clashes with the surroundings.
incongruously--adv.ex: He was incongruously dressed for a funeral.

indignantly--adv.def: In a way that shows anger at unfair treatment.

indiscrete--adj.ex: The data form an indiscrete mass.

indolence--noun.def: A habit of avoiding work or effort.

indolently--adv.ex: She stretched indolently in the sun.
